intro.h2: Kitchens and master baths, planned in detail
paragraphs: JC Remodeling Ro LLC handles kitchen and bath remodeling in the Cleveland, OH area. Julian, the owner, starts every job with a detailed work statement and is happy to share references from finished, ongoing and even difficult projects, so you know how we work before anything comes out of your house.

One homeowner says our kitchen remodel exceeded their expectations and singles out our attention to detail, professionalism and fair pricing. Another hired us for a master bathroom and got a shower with body sprays, a handheld and glass tile accents. He says we kept the workspace organized and clean, and made the remodel enjoyable.

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: We design kitchens around how your family gathers. The kitchen shown has a long white quartz island with seating for five, white shaker cabinets with brass pulls, a two-tone tile backsplash, a brass pot filler over the range and a dark floating shelf wall.

image.alt: Kitchen with a long quartz island, white shaker cabinets, brass hardware and a pot filler over the range

items.name: Cabinets, counters and shelving
items.blurb: Sometimes the right mix of materials makes the room. In this kitchen we paired white shaker cabinets with a speckled dark granite on the island and perimeter, a white subway tile backsplash to the ceiling and rustic wood floating shelves.

image.alt: White shaker kitchen with dark granite counters, a large island, white subway tile and rustic wood floating shelves

items.name: Master bathroom renovations
items.blurb: We take on full master bathrooms, from tearing out dated tubs to installing the vanity, lighting and mirror. Here a new vanity is going in under a large lit mirror, with the floors and counters covered while the work continues.

image.alt: Master bath under renovation with a new vanity base covered in plastic below a large lit mirror and new recessed lights

items.name: Custom showers
items.blurb: For one master bath we installed a luxury shower system with body sprays, a handheld and a main shower head on a master valve, plus decorative glass tile accents and carefully set-back niches. The homeowner says his wife absolutely loves it.

image.ai_prompt: Photorealistic photo of a finished walk-in tile shower in a Northeast Ohio colonial home master bath, large light gray porcelain wall tile, a vertical band of decorative glass mosaic accent tile, a recessed niche, a brushed nickel rain head, handheld shower and wall body sprays, frameless glass door, soft natural light from a small window, warm white and charcoal tones with a hint of brass, clean and finished, no people, no faces, no text, no logos, no brand names, 4:3
image.alt: Walk-in tile shower with a glass mosaic accent band, recessed niche, body sprays and a handheld shower

items.name: Tile floors
items.blurb: New floors set the stage for everything else. In this bathroom we laid large white wood-look plank tile in a staggered pattern before the walls were finished, with the new toilet flange and plumbing ready for the next stage of the remodel.

image.alt: New white wood-look plank tile floor in a bathroom with green board on the lower walls and the toilet flange in place

about.text: JC Remodeling Ro LLC is an owner-led remodeling company in the Cleveland, OH area. Julian, the owner, works with homeowners from the first written work statement through the final detail, and customers describe the team as professional, respectful and easy to work with. When a delivery slips, like a late shower door on one job, we keep you informed and reassured until the last piece is in. We may not be the lowest price you find, but our customers say the craftsmanship and service are worth it.

process.h2: How a remodel with us works

steps.title: Call and meet Julian
steps.text: Call (440) 289-2775 Monday through Friday, 7 AM to 5 PM. Julian will set a time to talk through your kitchen or bath.

steps.title: Detailed work statement
steps.text: You get a written work statement for the project, and we can share references from finished, ongoing and challenging jobs.

steps.title: Choose materials
steps.text: We help you pick tile, stone and fixtures, and point you to trusted vendors when you want to see options in person.

steps.title: Build and keep it clean
steps.text: Our crew keeps the jobsite organized and clean, and we keep you updated if a delivery or schedule changes.

steps.title: Final walkthrough
steps.text: We walk through the finished room together and take care of any final requests before the project is wrapped up.

items.name: Jeff H.
items.text: JC Remodeling did an outstanding job on our kitchen remodel and exceeded our expectations. Their attention to detail, professionalism, and fair pricing distinguish them from others in the industry. We would confidently recommend them and look forward to working with them again on future projects.

items.name: Ken L.
items.text:
Outstanding Master Bathroom Renovation by JC Remodeling Ro LLC

As a homeowner approaching a master bathroom remodel, I was impressed by JC Remodeling Ro LLC. Julian, the owner, demonstrated professionalism from the start by providing detailed work statements and references, including contacts for completed, ongoing, and challenging projects they had handled successfully.

Their team's quality of work exceeded expectations. They installed a luxury shower system featuring body sprays, a handheld shower, and a master valve shower head. The decorative glass tile accent work and perfectly crafted niche setbacks create a spa-like atmosphere that my wife absolutely loves.

What truly distinguished them was their attention to detail and professionalism. They maintained an organized and clean workspace throughout the renovation process. Julian went above and beyond by recommending excellent vendors for tile and stone that aligned with our vision. When we faced a delay with the shower door delivery, their reassurance and dedication to perfection helped maintain our confidence in the project.

While JC Remodeling Ro LLC may not be the lowest-priced option available, their exceptional craftsmanship and customer service justify the investment. The team treats your home with respect, responds positively to requests, and accommodates changes seamlessly. They turned what could have been a stressful renovation into an enjoyable experience.

I strongly recommend JC Remodeling Ro LLC for home renovation projects. Their combination of skilled craftsmanship and genuine customer care results in outstanding outcomes. Consider booking early, as their quality work keeps them in high demand.

items.q: Do you remodel both kitchens and bathrooms?
items.a: Yes. One customer hired us for a kitchen remodel that exceeded his expectations, and another for a full master bathroom renovation with a custom shower. Our photos show finished kitchens with large islands and bathrooms at different stages, from the old tub to new tile floors.

items.q: What will I get before work starts?
items.a: Julian provides a detailed work statement describing the project. If you want to hear from past clients, we can share references and contacts for completed, ongoing and challenging projects. You will know what is included before any demolition begins in your home.

items.q: Can you install a shower with body sprays?
items.a: Yes. In one master bath we installed a luxury shower system with body sprays, a handheld shower and a main head on a master valve. We added decorative glass tile accents and niche setbacks, and the homeowner says the room now feels like a spa.

Probably not, and we would rather be honest about it. One customer wrote that we may not be the lowest-priced option, but that our craftsmanship and service justify the investment. Another describes our pricing as fair. Call us to talk through your budget and what it can cover.

It depends on our schedule when you call. A past customer recommends booking early because our work keeps us in demand. Call (440) 289-2775 on a weekday between 7 AM and 5 PM, or email jcremodelingro@gmail.com to ask about current availability.
